title: Amazon's AI Shops for You!
full_monologue: **Amazon Just Launched an AI That Shops for You**. Imagine an AI that picks out clothes, groceries, and more based on your preferences. It's like having a personal shopper, but powered by AI. The tech uses your browsing and purchase history to make smart recommendations. Think of it as a digital concierge for your shopping needs. This could change how we interact with e-commerce forever. What do you think? Are you excited or concerned?
